title: UmbracoLicensesSchema
description: Defines the appsettings JSON schema for Umbraco Licenses configuration.

Umbraco.description: Configuration container for all Umbraco products.

UmbracoDefinition.description: Represents the configuration container for all Umbraco products.

LicensesSettings.description: Represents the settings for Umbraco licenses, including product license keys and validation options.

Products.description: Gets or sets a dictionary of product identifiers and license keys.

EnableScheduledValidation.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether the scheduled online validation checks are enabled.

ValidatedLicenseRelayAuthKey.description: Gets or sets a value for an authorization key used when relaying validated licenses for processing.
